title: rubus allegheniensis subvar. sativus
intro: Rubus allegheniensis subvar. sativus, commonly known as American black raspberry, is a subvariety of the Rubus allegheniensis plant, which is native to the eastern United States. American black raspberry is known for its antioxidant-rich properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and oxidative stress, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of American black raspberry include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as anthocyanins, ellagic acid, and salicylic acid. These bioactive constituents have been found to possess antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-inflammatory properties, making American black raspberry a valuable medicinal plant.
